card.ts01.oQueMostra: How many tasks completed in the period go into this screen's calculations.
card.ts01.comoCalcula: Counts the tasks with a done status and a resolution, resolved in the period, with consistent dates and within your view. The types and statuses that the card sheet excludes are left out.
card.ts02.oQueMostra: What share of the analyzed tasks' time was spent in active statuses.
card.ts02.comoCalcula: Time in active statuses ÷ total time outside done, summed over the analyzed tasks. Opening the card shows the analyzed tasks, which make up the numerator and the denominator.
card.ts03.oQueMostra: Open tasks stuck in their current status beyond what is normal for that status.
card.ts03.comoCalcula: Open for more than 1.5 × the status median (at least 2 days, in the chosen unit); the median comes from the tasks completed in the period.
card.ts04.oQueMostra: Median and P85 of the time completed tasks spent in each status.
card.ts04.comoCalcula: For each status, sums the stays per task (re-entries add up) and computes the median and P85 across the analyzed tasks; n is the number of tasks that went through the status.
card.ts05.oQueMostra: The relative weight of each status in the tasks' time, to find where they wait.
card.ts05.comoCalcula: Bar proportional to each status median, compared with the largest P85; same base and same n as the Time per status card.
card.ts06.oQueMostra: Median days of each person in each status, in alphabetical order and with no ranking.
card.ts06.comoCalcula: For each person and status, the median time the person was the assignee, across the analyzed tasks; n is the number of tasks. Bands: up to 3 days, 3 to 6 days, over 6 days.
card.ts07.oQueMostra: List of the open tasks stuck beyond normal.
card.ts07.comoCalcula: Same rule as the Stuck beyond normal card: time in the current status compared with the status median. The screen lists up to 50; the number counts all of them.
card.sy01.oQueMostra: Whether the panel is syncing with Jira or is switched off by the flag.
card.sy01.comoCalcula: Read from the configuration: periodic when the Jira flag is on, off when it is not. Only the user turns the flag on.
card.sy02.oQueMostra: The latest synchronizer runs for each instance, with counts and result.
card.sy02.comoCalcula: Read from the local database run log (up to 10 per instance): type, status, start, end, issues, events, requests and error code.
card.sy03.oQueMostra: The last local cleanup of old data.
card.au01.oQueMostra: How many changes to due dates, assignees and delay labels deserve a check in the period. Evidence, not proof.
card.au01.comoCalcula: Each change in the issue history (changelog) is compared with who could make it on the Manaus calendar date: the Reporter, coordination, the manager or the assignee's Squad Leader, with the roles in force that day. Counts the period's signals after the filters; opening the card lists the tasks behind it.
card.au02.oQueMostra: The count of signals of each type (due date, assignee change, ball-passing, delay labels, cancellation), in catalog order. There is no count per person.
card.au02.comoCalcula: Same universe as the Signals to review card, split by signal type. Limits and severities (days, swaps) come from the auditoria.yaml file.
card.au03.titulo: On time and adjusted on time
card.au03.oQueMostra: Of the completed tasks due in the period, how many were done by the due date (on time) and how many also counting those with a label that justifies the delay (adjusted on time).
card.au03.comoCalcula: Completed = done category and a filled-in resolution. On time: resolution day (Manaus time zone) up to the due date. Adjusted: on time or with a justified delay label (labels_atraso.yaml). A label under audit still counts and shows in the separate counter.
card.dv01.oQueMostra: Task and Review pairs with different due dates.
card.dv01.comoCalcula: Pair = task and Review linked by the issue link Blocks / is blocked by, in both directions (the parent field does not count). Mismatch: different due dates, or only one of them filled in. Percentage = mismatched ÷ pairs.
card.sy03.comoCalcula: Read from the retention run log. The cleanup only deletes local data and never talks to Jira.
auditoria.sub: Changes to due dates, assignees and delay labels made by someone who may not have been allowed to, to be reviewed. Coordination and manager only.
auditoria.aviso: Evidence, not proof: this screen shows changes to review, not conclusions about people.
auditoria.kpi.noPrazo.dica: {n} of {total} completed by the due date
auditoria.kpi.noPrazoAjustado.dica: {n} of {total}, counting those with a label that justifies the delay
auditoria.kpi.justificadas.dica: Late tasks adjusted by a label that also has a signal; they still count in the adjusted figure
auditoria.lista.limite: Showing {n} of {total} signals. Use the drawer or the CSV to see them all.
auditoria.emLote.dica: Same person, same field and same minute on {n} issues or more: context, not proof.
auditoria.semPermissao: Only coordination and the manager can see the audit. Ask the coordinator for access if you need it.
auditoria.filtroInvalido: A filter is invalid. Check the dates (From cannot be after To; 180 days at most) and the fields, and apply again.
auditoria.erro: The audit could not be loaded.
auditoria.aviso.REPORTER_ALTERADO: {n} issue(s) with a reporter change in the history: authorization uses the current reporter and may have been checked against the wrong PL.
auditoria.aviso.VENCIMENTO_ILEGIVEL: {n} unreadable due date value(s) in the history were ignored in the comparisons.
auditoria.aviso.ISSUES_IGNORADAS_STATUS: {n} issue(s) with unmapped status "{status}" were left out (see Data quality).
auditoria.aviso.VINCULO_AMBIGUO: {n} ambiguous Task × Review link(s): the pair with the lowest key was kept.
auditoria.aviso.VINCULOS_INDISPONIVEIS: No link of the configured Blocks type in the database: the Task × Review card stays empty until the next sync.

auditoria.sinal.RESPONSAVEL_TROCADO_NAO_: Assignee changed by someone not allowed to

auditoria.sinal.LABEL_APOS_FECHAMENTO_NA: Delay label after closing, by someone not allowed to
auditoria.sinal.LABEL_PELO_RESPONSAVEL_A: Delay label after closing, by the assignee
auditoria.sinal.LABEL_APOS_VENCIMENTO: Delay label after the due date

cardpage.semPermissao: Your role does not allow viewing this data. Squad Leaders see their own squad; users see only their own. Ask your coordinator for access if you need it.
cardpage.filtroInvalido: A filter is invalid. Check the dates (From cannot be after To), the squad and the person, and apply again.
cardpage.erro: The card could not be loaded.
cardpage.avisos.bloqueante.ajuda: The numbers are unavailable (—) until the problem is fixed; see Data quality.
cardpage.aviso.AMOSTRA_PEQUENA: Few {tipo} tasks in the history ({n} of at least {minimo}): the percentiles are unstable.
cardpage.aviso.CAMPOS_DE_TRABALHO_INDISP: Priority and estimates have not been synchronized yet: those numbers show empty until the next synchronization.
cardpage.aviso.SEM_HISTORICO_DO_TIPO: {n} task(s) of a type with no completed history were left out of the P85 comparison.
cardpage.aviso.DONE_SEM_RESOLUTION: {n} task(s) in a done status without a resolution were left out of the numbers (see Data quality).
cardpage.aviso.ORDEM_DO_FLUXO_AUSENTE: The flow order (status_map) is not configured.
card.ab01.oQueMostra: How many tasks are open right now and, of those, how many are in progress.
card.ab01.comoCalcula: Open = no resolution date and outside the done category (Cancelled, Canceled and Dropped are left out). In progress = active, waiting or blocked status, or with the impediment flag. Follows the view of your role.
card.ab02.titulo: Historical age by type (P50 and P85)
card.ab02.oQueMostra: How long the tasks of each type took, from the start of work to completion, over the last 16 weeks: the reference for deciding whether an open task is old.
card.ab02.comoCalcula: Cycle of the completed tasks (done category, a resolution that is not a cancellation, and a resolution date) from the last 16 weeks, in business or calendar days. P50 and P85 per type, using only the tasks in your view; with fewer than 5 tasks the number shows with a small-sample warning.
card.ab04.oQueMostra: In-progress tasks older than 85% of the completed tasks of the same type: candidates for attention.
card.ab04.comoCalcula: Age (from the start of work until now) greater than the P85 of the historical cycle of its OWN type. In-progress tasks only; a type with no completed history is not counted (there is a warning). Same time unit as the screen.
card.ab05.oQueMostra: How many open tasks are in each status, in flow order.
card.ab05.comoCalcula: Count of open tasks by current status. The order comes from status_map.yaml (ordem); statuses outside the order go last.
card.ab06.oQueMostra: How many open tasks there are for each Jira priority.
card.ab06.comoCalcula: Count of open tasks by the synchronized priority. While no task has a synchronized priority the card stays empty with a warning, and never shows everything as unprioritized.
card.ab07.oQueMostra: How many open tasks are in each age band: up to 7, 8 to 14, 15 to 30 and more than 30 days.
card.ab07.comoCalcula: Age = from the start of work (or from creation, if it never started) until now, in the chosen unit (business or calendar days).
card.ab08.oQueMostra: How many open tasks are already overdue, due within 7 days, due later or have no due date.
card.ab08.comoCalcula: Due date compared with today in Manaus: overdue = before today; within 7 days = from today to today + 7; later = beyond that; none = no due date.
card.ab09.oQueMostra: All the open tasks in your view, with status, priority, age, due date and remaining hours; sortable and exportable.
card.ab09.comoCalcula: Same universe as the Open card. Remaining hours come from the Jira remaining estimate and stay empty when the task has none.
card.ng01.oQueMostra: In-progress tasks that Jira has not updated for more than 7 days.
card.ng01.comoCalcula: In progress (active, waiting or blocked) and the update date (updated) more than 7 calendar days old. A comment also updates it, which is why each row shows the last real movement.
card.ng02.oQueMostra: Open tasks that nobody has taken.
card.ng02.comoCalcula: Open tasks with an empty assignee. Only coordination and managers see this queue.
card.ng03.oQueMostra: Open tasks whose due date has passed.
card.ng03.comoCalcula: Due date before today (Manaus day), in any open status.
card.ng04.oQueMostra: Open tasks that are blocked or flagged with an impediment.
card.ng04.comoCalcula: Blocked category in the status map, or the impediment flag turned on in Jira.
card.ng05.oQueMostra: In-progress tasks that have been in the same status for too long.
card.ng05.comoCalcula: In progress only. Time in the current status greater than the larger of 3 days and 2 times the median of that status among the tasks completed in the last 16 weeks (only 3 days when there is no median). It is a separate list from No update.
card.ng06.titulo: To do for more than 30 days
card.ng06.oQueMostra: Tasks that have been waiting in the queue for more than 30 days.
card.ng06.comoCalcula: To-do category for more than 30 calendar days in the current status (or since creation, if it never changed status).
card.fe01.oQueMostra: How many tasks were completed in the period.
card.fe01.comoCalcula: Completed = done category, a resolution that is not a cancellation, and a resolution date. The day is the Manaus day of the resolution. Follows the view of your role.
card.fe02.oQueMostra: Sum of the points of the tasks completed in the period; opens the completed tasks that have points.
card.fe02.comoCalcula: Sum of the Story Points field of the completed tasks. A task without points adds nothing and does not count as zero; with no synchronized points the value stays empty.
card.fe03.oQueMostra: How long the completed tasks took from the start of work to the resolution.
card.fe03.comoCalcula: From the first entry into in-progress, waiting or blocked until the resolution, in business or calendar days. P50 and P85 by linear interpolation. Opens the completed tasks that enter the calculation.
card.fe04.oQueMostra: How long the completed tasks took from creation to the resolution.
card.fe04.comoCalcula: From creation to the resolution, in business or calendar days. P50 and P85 by linear interpolation.
card.fe05.titulo: On time and adjusted on time
card.fe05.oQueMostra: Of the completed tasks due in the period, how many were done by the due date and how many were done by the due date also counting those with a label that justifies the delay.
card.fe05.comoCalcula: Same rule as Audit and Goals: positive completion, not an Epic, due in the period. On time = Manaus day of the resolution up to the due date. Adjusted = on time or with a label from labels_atraso.yaml.
card.fe06.oQueMostra: Tasks closed with a cancellation resolution in the period and tasks in a done status without a resolution.
card.fe06.comoCalcula: Cancelled: done category with a cancellation resolution (status_map.yaml). Without resolution: entered a done status in the period without a resolution; goes to Data quality and does not count as a delivery.
card.fe07.oQueMostra: How many tasks were completed in each week (Monday to Sunday, Manaus time).
card.fe07.comoCalcula: Completed tasks grouped by the Monday of the week of the Manaus day of the resolution. A resolution on Sunday at 11:30 pm in Manaus falls in the week that ends on that Sunday.
card.fe08.oQueMostra: Each completed task as a point (resolution day and cycle days), with P50, P85 and P95.
card.fe08.comoCalcula: Cycle of each completed task, in the chosen unit. Percentiles use linear interpolation over all completed tasks that have a cycle.
card.fe09.oQueMostra: P50 and P85 of the cycle of each task type; types are never mixed.
card.fe09.comoCalcula: Percentiles of the cycle of the completed tasks of each type. With fewer than 5 tasks the number shows with a small-sample warning.
card.fe10.oQueMostra: How many completed tasks there are per project (key prefix).
card.fe10.comoCalcula: Completed tasks of the period grouped by the project of the task key (for example, TG).
card.fe11.oQueMostra: How many tasks each person finished and how many they took part in, with points, cycle and estimated and logged hours. No ranking: alphabetical order.
card.fe11.comoCalcula: Finished = was the assignee at the resolution. Took part = had the task at some point. Hours come from the estimate and time-spent fields of the task itself (per-person worklog is left for a future phase). Only people in your view.
card.fe12.oQueMostra: All the completed tasks of the period with cycle, lead, due date, deadline status and hours; sortable and exportable.
card.fe12.comoCalcula: Same universe as the Completed card. Deadline status: on time, adjusted (delay label), late or no due date. The table shows up to 500 rows; the count and the drawer bring all of them.
card.mt01.titulo: On time and adjusted on time
card.mt01.oQueMostra: Of the completed tasks due in the period, how many were done by the due date (on time) and how many also counting those with a label that justifies the delay (adjusted on time), side by side.
card.mt01.comoCalcula: Universe = completed tasks (done category, a resolution that is not a cancellation, a resolution date), not an Epic, due in the period. On time = Manaus day of the resolution up to the due date. Adjusted = on time or with a label from labels_atraso.yaml. Same rule as Audit and Completed.
card.mt02.titulo: On time by the original date
card.mt02.oQueMostra: How many tasks were done by the FIRST agreed due date, before deadlines were rescheduled.
card.mt02.comoCalcula: The original due date is the previous value of the first due-date change in the changelog (or the current one, if it never changed). The screen warns when the original rate is 5 percentage points or more below the rate by the current date (limit in metas.yaml).
card.mt03.oQueMostra: Tasks completed at least 1 day before the due date.
card.mt03.comoCalcula: Manaus day of the resolution minus the due date less than or equal to −1. The early target comes from metas.yaml.
card.mt04.oQueMostra: Tasks completed 1 or 2 days before the due date.
card.mt04.comoCalcula: Manaus day of the resolution minus the due date equal to −1 or −2.
card.mt05.oQueMostra: Tasks completed exactly on the due date.
card.mt05.comoCalcula: Manaus day of the resolution equal to the due date. A resolution at 11:30 pm in Manaus counts on that day, even though it is already the next day in UTC.
card.mt06.oQueMostra: Tasks completed after the due date.
card.mt06.comoCalcula: Manaus day of the resolution greater than the due date. Those with a label that justifies the delay stay here and also count as adjusted on time.
card.mt07.oQueMostra: Tasks completed in the period that have no due date and therefore stay out of the deadline rates.
card.mt07.comoCalcula: Positively completed tasks resolved in the period (Manaus day), not an Epic, with no due date.
card.mt08.oQueMostra: How many tasks of the universe are due in each period (day, week or month), split into on the day, early and late.
card.mt08.comoCalcula: The universe grouped by the period of the DUE DATE. Week = Monday to Sunday in Manaus; month = calendar month. Only periods with tasks appear.
card.mt09.oQueMostra: The on-time rate in each period, compared with the target.
card.mt09.comoCalcula: On time divided by the universe of each due-date period. The target line comes from metas.yaml. Each point opens the tasks that were on time in that period.
card.mt10.oQueMostra: How many tasks were done in each band relative to the due date: 3 or more days early, 2 days early, 1 day early, on the day, 1 to 3 days late and more than 3 days late.
card.mt10.comoCalcula: Bands of the difference between the Manaus day of the resolution and the due date: ≤ −3, −2, −1, 0, 1 to 3 and > 3.
card.mt11.oQueMostra: Universe, on time and adjusted on time for each task type, with the state against the target.
card.mt11.comoCalcula: Same universe as the On time card, by task type (alphabetical order). State: ✓ at or above the target, ● up to 10 percentage points below, ▲ further below (metas.yaml).
card.mt12.oQueMostra: Universe, on time and adjusted on time for each priority, with the state against the target.
card.mt12.comoCalcula: Same universe as the On time card, by synchronized priority (priority order; unprioritized last). Same state as the other tables.
card.mt13.oQueMostra: Universe, on time and adjusted on time for each squad, with the state against the target.
card.mt13.comoCalcula: The squad is the assignee's squad on the resolution day, from the role directory. Alphabetical order, never by rate.
card.mt14.oQueMostra: Universe, on time and adjusted on time for each person in your view, with the state against the target. No ranking: alphabetical order.
card.mt14.comoCalcula: The person is the assignee on the resolution day. Only people in your view; alphabetical order, with no position and no comparison between people.
abertas.pergunta: What is open right now, for how long, and what is due?
abertas.kpi.acimaDoP85.dica: In progress and older than the P85 of its own type
abertas.historico: Historical age by type (cycle of completed tasks, 16 weeks)
abertas.historico.vazio: No completed tasks in the history of your view to compare against.
abertas.tabela.vazia: No open tasks in your view.
abertas.prioridade.indisponivel: Priority not synchronized yet: no numbers here until the next synchronization.

negligenciadas.lista.aFazer: To do for more than 30 days
negligenciadas.dica.semAtualizacao: In progress and not updated in Jira for more than {n} days
negligenciadas.dica.bloqueadas: Blocked or flagged with an impediment
negligenciadas.dica.paradas: In progress for too long in the same status
negligenciadas.dica.aFazer: In the queue for more than 30 days
negligenciadas.filtro.semMovimentoReal.a: Showing only the tasks with no real movement (status, assignee, due date, labels or resolution) for more than {n} days.
fechadas.pergunta: What was delivered in the period, how fast, and on time?
fechadas.kpi.pontos.vazio: No completed task with synchronized points
fechadas.kpi.semResolution.dica: Left out of the deliveries; see Data quality
fechadas.dispersao.vazia: No measured cycle in the period.
fechadas.porTipo.vazio: No completed tasks with a cycle in the period.
fechadas.porPessoa.vazio: Nobody in your view delivered in the period.
fechadas.porPessoa.nota: Alphabetical order, no ranking. Hours come from the estimate and time-spent fields of the task itself.
fechadas.tabela.vazia: No tasks completed in the period.
metas.pergunta: Were the deliveries done by the due date? And by the originally agreed date?
metas.prazo: On time and adjusted on time
metas.kpi.universo: Universe (completed tasks due in the period)
metas.kpi.original: On time by the original date
metas.kpi.semVencimento.dica: Completed in the period, outside the rates
metas.alertaDataOriginal: The rate by the current date is well above the rate by the original date: deadlines were rescheduled. Check the Audit.
metas.distribuicao: Resolution day against the due date
metas.serie.vazia: No due dates in the period.
metas.tabela.vazia: No tasks in the universe for this table.
metas.rodape: Rules: {versao}. Universe rate: completed tasks due in the period, excluding Epics and cancelled tasks.
